newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks still firming, Dow up 101.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks still firming, Dow up 101.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks followed bonds still higher in late afternoon, pushing gains on the Dow Jones Industrial Average over 100 points.

Large cap stocks continued to outperform, fueled by buy programs. The Dow rose as many as 107 points before settling back to 6650, up 101 points. In contrast, the Russell 2000 was up one point to 365.

"It's certainly looks like a program-led rally," said Michael Metz, chief investment strategist at Oppenheimer and Co. "I have to say, this is rather impressive ahead of what is supposed to be an important employment number tomorrow."
The benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury also continued to climb, rising 1-2/32 to yield 6.76 percent.
